summary: This bill renames the block of 16th Street NW between H and K Streets in DC (formerly Black Lives Matter Plaza) to Charlie Kirk Freedom of Speech Plaza and requires the District to install at least two new matching street signs at the intersections within 90 days.

scores.thoughts: The bill requires the District of Columbia to construct and install a small number of street signs. This entails negligible public expenditure and does not address overall government spending levels, budgets, or fiscal policy in any substantive way.
